description: Benchmark mappings and separately documented current subscription routes. A benchmark row does not by itself imply routeability.

families.label: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra account-discovered route
families.notes: The 2026-09-06 AA xhigh row is the shared reference: Hermes 245e480 clamps Astra max to xhigh. Vendor max is separate. Route eligibility requires the selected accounts' live catalogs; Plus/Pro alone is not evidence of rollout access.

families.label: OpenAI GPT-5.6 subscription routes
families.notes: GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna retain direct Artificial Analysis max-effort rows in the 2026-09-06 snapshot.

families.label: Z AI GLM core family
families.notes: GLM-5.3 and vision-capable GLM-5.3-Flash are both Coding Plan eligible. AA labels GLM-5.3 max; the Flash row has no effort suffix. Coding endpoints may server-route older 5.2/5.1 IDs to 5.3.

families.label: Moonshot Kimi K3 benchmark reference
families.notes: AA max-effort API reference only. Moonshot API billing is separate from Kimi Coding membership. The low-effort AA row is retained as reference data but does not share the canonical max mapping.

families.label: Kimi Coding membership routes
families.notes: K3 routes use the AA K3 max row as an explicit quality reference, not a measurement of the membership endpoint or its default high effort. k3-256k is the Moderato+ starter; 1M k3 and HighSpeed require Allegretto+. No endpoint TPS/TTFT is inferred from the API row.

families.label: Kimi Coding K2.7 membership compatibility routes
families.notes: K2.7 Code quality reference only; no claim of matching membership endpoint throughput. HighSpeed requires Allegretto+. These IDs are distinct from K3 and must not receive its benchmark row.

families.label: Moonshot Kimi K2 family
families.notes: Legacy Moonshot API references, not Kimi membership entitlements. Current Moonshot defaults to K3; K2.7 Code is always-thinking.

families.label: MiniMax hosted family
families.notes: MiniMax-M3 is the current hosted default; M2.7 remains a compatibility fallback.

families.label: Qwen Cloud benchmark reference
families.notes: Qwen Cloud remains outside automatic subscription routing. 3.8 uses Standard PAYG or a separate Token Plan, not the old Coding Plan. AA has no direct 3.8 Flash or dated Max-0902 row; Flash-Next is a different model and must not be substituted.

families.label: Legacy Qwen Portal compatibility catalog
families.notes: Legacy qwen-oauth with qwen-portal/qwen-cli aliases. OpenClaw 679193c removes Portal; Hermes 245e480 still supports it. Retained for existing compatible runtimes, never a fresh current-OpenClaw starter or Qwen Cloud entitlement.

families.label: xAI Grok OAuth routeable family
families.notes: Grok 4.6 and 4.5 have direct high-effort AA rows in the 2026-09-06 snapshot; the old 4.3 proxy is retired. Other 4.6 efforts remain separate reference rows. Only subscription-backed OAuth is eligible; xAI API billing and the moving auto/build-latest aliases do not inherit these scores.
